title: Puget Sound Sports Fishing
specs: Fishing for Blackmouth, Chinook, Coho, Pink, Chum, Sockeye salmon year-round
Scenic views of Mount Rainier, Olympic Mountains, Mount Baker, and Cascade Range
Wildlife sightings including whales, orcas, sea lions, porpoises, eagles, and hawks
Fishing license required ($12 or $10 on boat for one-day license)
No previous fishing experience necessary; average physical condition required
Open group charters for 3-6 people; solo participants may be placed with others
Private group charters for 4-6 people with exclusive boat use
includes: Cleaning and bagging of your fish
All equipment, rods, reels, bait, and tackle
Captained by U.S. Coast Guard licensed skippers
All boats fully licensed with Washington State Department of Fisheries and U.S. Coast Guard Approved
blurb: Guests fish for various salmon species and bottom fish in Puget Sound waters from Seattle to Everett. Trips include all gear, bait, and tackle, with cleaning and bagging of fish provided. Options include open group charters and private group charters for 4-6 people.
